description: One thing that could be done about one threat, and which kind of control it is. The CONTROL METHOD is the field that matters: it is what the sustainability score is computed from, and it is what turns 'we do IPM' from a claim into a number a certifier can audit. An action with no method named is scored as Unclassified and drags the score down deliberately — an unclassified answer is one nobody can show was anything other than a spray.

fields.description: Which rung of the IPM ladder this action is on. Cultural and Biological sit above Mechanical, which sits above Behavioral, which sits above Chemical — that ordering is the whole of integrated pest management and it is what the sustainability score reads. 'No Action' is a real and often correct answer: a pest over threshold with its predators eating it is a block already handling itself.
fields.label: Control Method
fields.options:
Cultural
Biological
Mechanical
Behavioral
Chemical
No Action
Unclassified

fields.description: What to do, in the words somebody will act on. 'Release Typhlodromus at 2000/acre', not 'consider biological control'.
fields.label: Action

fields.description: Proposed is generated and not yet judged. Rejected is kept rather than deleted — a farm that declined the biological option four times running has a pattern worth seeing, and a deleted row hides it.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Lower runs first. The generated order puts the least chemical option at the top, which is the order an IPM programme is supposed to consider them in.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: The material, where there is one. A Chemical action with no product named is a decision nobody has finished making.
fields.label: Product

fields.description: When it stops being useful. Most IPM actions have a window rather than a deadline — a dormant oil applied at pink is not late, it is wrong.
fields.label: Due By

fields.description: The work order raised for this action, where one was. It is what connects a recommendation to somebody's actual day.
fields.label: Farm Task
